text:
maria_cs: FYI @sam_sales @clara_accounting — Northbridge invoice didn't reflect the $120,000 PO credit sales added on 2026-03-01. Customer opened a ticket and is escalating. PO: NB-PO-2026-3345. Can someone confirm if the credit was attached to their billing account or a different subaccount?

sam_sales: I added the credit manually yesterday per contract note "Q1 Promo". I attached it to PO NB-PO-2026-3345 under sales_account: `acct-nb-190`. Is the customer's billing account `acct-nb-001`? Maybe mismatch.

jordan_account_manager: Customer billing profile is `acct-nb-001` (verified). Sales used `acct-nb-190` (internal). That'd explain it. Clara, can you check ledger for entries matching NB-PO-2026-3345?

clara_accounting: Looking now. Querying ledger... here's the row I see:
```
ledger_entry_id: L-778392
amount: -120000
applied_to_account: acct-nb-190
note: 'NB Q1 Promo — per Sales PO NB-PO-2026-3345'
```
Not applied to acct-nb-001. I'll need a manual reassign.

maria_cs: Customer expects the credit before month's bill closes EOD. Are manual moves allowed? Any policy blocking moving credits across accounts?

ryan_ops: We can reapply credits but need the PO note + approval from Sales + Accounting signoff. Also must ensure audit trail. I can run the ledger reassign; will need an email consent chain.

sam_sales: I can send a confirmation email from legal/sales with verbatim PO and authorization. Putting together now. ETA 30m.

maria_cs: Steps for repro & fix — please confirm:
1) Verify ledger entry exists (clara)
2) Sales confirmation email (sam)
3) Ops run reassign script with audit tag (ryan)
4) CS confirm credit visible in billing portal (maria)

If we need a temporary credit for immediate relief we can grant a customer-facing free trial credit via the portal for $10,000, but we prefer fix on PO.

clara_accounting: I've prepared a manual adjustment request: MA-2026-4832 pending approval. I'll attach the ledger row + proof. Approving now.

devops_bot: Runbook triggered: `ops/reassign-credit` — requires 2 approvals. Approver list: clara_accounting, sam_sales.

ryan_ops: Starting reassign now. Command:
```
./reassign_credit --entry L-778392 --from acct-nb-190 --to acct-nb-001 --tag 'PO-reassign NB-PO-2026-3345'
```
Will post logs when done.

ryan_ops: Done. Output:
```
status: success
new_applied_to: acct-nb-001
audit_id: AUD-9912
```
Please verify on billing portal.

maria_cs: Verified with customer on call — credit shows and invoice updated. Customer relieved. Sam/Clara — please add PO note to contract and confirm invoice note. Closing on my side. :tada:

sam_sales: :thumbsup: I updated contract in Salesforce and added note to PO. Sending reconciliation email to customer.

clara_accounting: Logged MA-2026-4832 as completed and attached audit AUD-9912. Closing ticket.
